issues.claim: Sections are not merged as objects: an array becomes keys `Section:0`, `Section:1` and so on, so a shorter array in `appsettings.Development.json` replaces only the elements with the same indexes
issues.problem: The opening sentence is wrong as stated. Configuration is flattened to key-value pairs, so object sections ARE merged key by key across providers. Only arrays behave surprisingly, because they become indexed keys. A candidate would learn that object sections are replaced wholesale, and that is false. The array example that follows is correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the first clause with: "Values are merged key by key, not replaced as whole sections, and arrays are the surprising case: an array becomes keys `Section:0`, `Section:1` and so on, so a shorter array in `appsettings.Development.json` overrides only the elements with the same indexes, and the extra elements from `appsettings.json` remain." Make the same change in the Russian text: "Значения сливаются по ключам, а не заменяются секциями целиком; ловушка - массивы: массив превращается в ключи `Section:0`, `Section:1` и так далее, поэтому ...".
